rationale: Four floor runs (7.02 ns target, 0.4/0.4 margins) gave T_eff 6.33-6.48 with ample feasibility headroom: hold +0.09 ns, no hold buffers, 0 slew/cap pins vs 309, DRC clears, wirelength ~8% over estimate. Setup is limited at ss 100C max-RC by an I/O-port path whose slack stays 0.68-0.69 ns across util 41-45, density, slew/cap margins and sizing, so it is set by the floor target rather than these knobs. Only low util (32) regressed, becoming reg-to-reg-limited (6.48). Sizing off matched T_eff and gave the best reg-to-reg (+0.87 vs +0.74 in the otherwise near-identical sizing-on run), which helps when the best run is re-run at tighter clocks, where period-scaled I/O delays ease the port path. Keep all pins.
